title: Interpretable Brain Age Prediction Using White Matter Fiber Orientation Distributions with Rotation-Equivariant Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) provides information about white matter microstructure that can support brain age prediction. However, many existing prediction models use diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) scalar metrics that omit orientation information. Deep learning is increasingly used for brain age prediction, but conventional CNNs do not explicitly respect the geometric structure of orientation-dependent features. We present an interpretable brain age prediction framework that combines white matter fiber orientation distributions (WM-FODs) with an SE(3) (Special Euclidean group in 3 dimensions) equivariant CNN. The network operates directly on spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients of the FOD, preserving their transformation properties under rotation. Evaluation in 692 participants aged 36-90 years from the Human Connectome Project Aging dataset showed that the combined framework outperformed the evaluated DTI-based models and conventional CNNs.

translated_title: 使用白质纤维取向分布与旋转等变深度学习的可解释脑龄预测
translated_abstract: 扩散磁共振成像（dMRI）能够提供白质微结构信息，从而支持脑龄预测。然而，许多现有的预测模型使用扩散张量成像（DTI）标量指标，这些指标忽略了取向信息。深度学习正越来越多地用于脑龄预测，但传统的卷积神经网络（CNN）并没有显式地遵循取向相关特征的几何结构。我们提出了一个可解释的脑龄预测框架，将白质纤维取向分布（WM-FODs）与SE(3)（三维特殊欧几里得群）等变卷积神经网络相结合。该网络直接在FOD的球谐（SH）系数上运行，保留了它们在旋转下的变换特性。在人脑连接组计划老化数据集（HCP-Aging）中692名年龄在36至90岁之间的参与者上的评估表明，这一组合框架优于所评估的基于DTI的模型和传统卷积神经网络。
tldr: 该论文提出将白质纤维取向分布与SE(3)旋转等变卷积神经网络相结合的可解释脑龄预测框架，直接在球谐系数上操作以保留旋转变换特性，在HCP-Aging数据集上表现优于基于DTI的模型和传统CNN。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an interpretable brain age prediction framework that combines white matter fiber orientation distributions with an SE(3) rotation-equivariant CNN operating directly on spherical harmonic coefficients, outperforming DTI-based models and conventional CNNs on the HCP-Aging dataset.
